news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.76 (vs ₹1.89 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.76 (up from ₹1.89 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹227.9m (up 264% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹61.6m (up ₹81.8m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 27% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 33% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year.
